lead: An inline array literal is `array<mixed>`, so a typed `foreach` binding or a generic `T` bound from one fails.
body: `rule:types/conversion` leaves an untyped literal unplaced, so the `foreach` binding is `E0401` at the binding and `string $one = Core\Cli::select("q", ["a", "b"])` is `E0401: expected string, found mixed` because `crate::generics::bind` reads `array<mixed>`. Name the array's type where it is built (`array<string> $choices = [...]`), not where it is walked or passed.
